The image displays a geometric pattern composed of green triangles arranged in a tessellated, mountain-like formation against a white background. The design features a series of peaks and valleys created by the arrangement of triangles. The triangles vary in shade, ranging from light green to dark green, which creates a sense of depth and contour. The pattern is symmetrical along a central vertical axis, with the tallest peaks located in the center and left side of the image. The overall shape resembles a stylized mountain range or a digital representation of a terrain map.

The image displays a graphic logo or title card featuring the text "CLASS 8" in a bold, black, sans-serif font. The number "8" is significantly larger than the text and is colored light gray. To the right of the number "8", there is a decorative element consisting of a cluster of green triangles pointing upwards. The background of the image is white.
